G5-RUNTIME-IDENTITY-001.root_cause: Each production backend restarted opaque handle counters at one; a fresh instance could accept a retired capability for a different representation.
G5-RUNTIME-IDENTITY-001.fix: One exhaustion-checked atomic process-local Runtime capability namespace, reserved before external materialization/path acceptance. Not semantic identity or digest input.

G5-RUNTIME-IDENTITY-002.root_cause: Binding generations restarted at one on fresh services and forget/recreate; generation-only stale commands could mutate a new binding.
G5-RUNTIME-IDENTITY-002.fix: Exhaustion-checked process-local binding capability allocation. Remove reuse, preserve monotonicity and validate stale commands. Numeric adjacency/reset-to-one were unsafe incidental behavior, not durable identity.

G5-RESTORE-ENTITY-HANDLE-001.regression: FreshWholeEngineRestoresAllPlanesAndContinuesCausally rejects retired handles; Entities tests reject cross-owner Create and replaced owner handles.
G5-RESTORE-ENTITY-HANDLE-001.root_cause: Fresh EntityService rebuilt generation one and accepted a stale handle from the destroyed composition.
G5-RESTORE-ENTITY-HANDLE-001.fix: Bounded atomic process-local generation reservations for every issued Create/Restore handle; source durable IDs and snapshot schema unchanged.

G5-RESTORE-CONDITION-PROJECTION-001.root_cause: A retained Conditions journal obtains a new observation epoch on restore. ReconcileAll replaced an unchanged Progression projection, consuming durable modifier IDs and incrementing revisions.
G5-RESTORE-CONDITION-PROJECTION-001.fix: Compare every derived modifier field with the existing source projection before replacement. Preserve identical durable IDs, generators and revisions; changed projections retain the atomic replacement path.
G5-RESTORE-CONDITION-PROJECTION-001.regression: RetainedConditionJournalReconcilesWithoutChangingProgression: failing semantic comparison before the fix; restored epoch reconciliation and repeated processing preserve the complete canonical Progression snapshot.

G5-RESTORE-VALIDATION-VIEW-001.root_cause: SnapshotParticipant validation cloned adapters against fresh live peer owners before the saved peer snapshots were staged. Nonempty valid DeathReward checkpoints were rejected against the empty Combat journal.
G5-RESTORE-VALIDATION-VIEW-001.fix: Restore-scoped private validation candidates resolved in dependency order, shared by participants and discarded on every exit. Separate Validate, Stage and no-throw Commit phases remain intact.
G5-RESTORE-VALIDATION-VIEW-001.regression: NonemptyCrossOwnerRestoreUsesSavedDependencies preserves exact durable bytes on precommit failure, restores successfully on the same-composition retry, and processes the restored delivery ledger without duplicate semantic changes.

G5-RESTORE-DEATH-ENUM-001.root_cause: DeathReward RestoreCheckpoint accepted unknown durable delivery-state enum values because it validated keys and generated rewards but omitted the enum domain check.
G5-RESTORE-DEATH-ENUM-001.fix: Reject every state outside Generated and Pending before publishing either the cursor or delivery ledger.
G5-RESTORE-DEATH-ENUM-001.regression: DeathRewardRejectsUnknownDeliveryStateAtomically failed with state 99 before the fix, then rejected it without changing the full semantic checkpoint.
